A nice restaurant offering Indian and punjabi food in Ho Chi Minh City district 1 offering veg, non veg, vegan dishes
Jun 2024 • Family
A nice restaurant offering Indian and punjabi food in Ho Chi Minh City district 1. It’s barely a 5-7 minute walk from Vien Dong hotel where we stayed. The restaurant is inside a well lit up street and also very close to the Bui Vien walking street. It has some good Indian food. Dal makhani , poori chhole, paneer, Palak and lot more. Offers vegan options and non veg as well. The food is good. Quantity is average like serves max two. Rates of Indian food are higher here as compared to local food. Service is nice. Seating is decent. Menu is extensive. Run by an Indian who was nice to talk to. Helped us with a lot of information on the area, what to do, how and where to visit etc
